brief:
The environmental toll of Israel's war on Gaza—including destroyed water infrastructure, damaged agricultural land, and compromised sanitation systems—took center stage at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference in Antalya, the Palestine News Network reported. Delegates examined cascading humanitarian consequences tied to ecological destruction across the territory.

The discussion focused particular attention on how environmental degradation disproportionately affects women and children in Gaza, linking climate impacts to vulnerable populations already facing acute shortages of water and food security amid ongoing conflict.

title: Gaza war devastates environment, climate conference told
